# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:tools` from the tool registry. Do not edit by hand; CI runs `npm run docs:check`. -->

Every tool is read-only and queries public NASA/JPL services. Unknown parameters are rejected. Legacy names are accepted as aliases but not listed by `tools/list`.

## `nasa_apod` — NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day

Fetch NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD): a single date, a date range (up to 100 days), or random pictures. Requires NASA_API_KEY.

Aliases: `nasa/apod`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `date` | string |  |  | Date of the picture (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today. Cannot be combined with count or start_date/end_date. |
| `start_date` | string |  |  | Start of a date range (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `end_date` | string |  |  | End of a date range (YYYY-MM-DD); requires start_date. Defaults to today when start_date is given. |
| `count` | integer (1–100) |  |  | Return this many random pictures (1-100). Cannot be combined with dates. |
| `thumbs` | boolean |  |  | Include thumbnail URLs for video entries. |
| `max_images` | integer (0–5) |  | `1` | How many pictures to embed as image content (0-5). Remaining entries are listed by URL. |

## `nasa_neo` — NASA Near Earth Object Web Service

Near-Earth asteroid close approaches from NASA NeoWs: a feed for up to 7 days (defaults to today, UTC) or a single asteroid by ID. Requires NASA_API_KEY.

Aliases: `nasa/neo`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `start_date` | string |  |  | Start date for the close-approach feed (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today (UTC). |
| `end_date` | string |  |  | End date (YYYY-MM-DD), at most 7 days after start_date. Defaults to start_date. |
| `asteroid_id` | string |  |  | Look up one asteroid by its NeoWs ID instead of the date feed. |

## `nasa_epic` — NASA EPIC Earth imagery

Earth Polychromatic Imaging Camera (DSCOVR) full-disc Earth images for a day: metadata for every image plus a bounded number embedded.

Aliases: `nasa/epic`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `collection` | `"natural"` \\| `"enhanced"` |  | `"natural"` | Image collection. |
| `date` | string |  |  | Date of the images (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the most recent available day. |
| `max_images` | integer (0–3) |  | `1` | How many images to embed (0-3, JPEG). All images are listed with PNG and JPEG URLs. |

## `nasa_gibs` — NASA GIBS satellite imagery

Render a Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS) layer for a date and bounding box as an image (WMS GetMap, EPSG:4326).

Aliases: `nasa/gibs`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `layer` | string | yes |  | GIBS layer identifier, e.g. MODIS_Terra_CorrectedReflectance_TrueColor |
| `date` | string | yes |  | Imagery date (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `format` | `"png"` \\| `"jpg"` \\| `"jpeg"` |  | `"png"` | Image format. |
| `resolution` | number (>0–40) |  | `2` | Output resolution in pixels per degree (default 2, i.e. 720x360 for the whole globe). |
| `bbox` | string or number[] |  |  | Area as west,south,east,north in decimal degrees (EPSG:4326). Defaults to the whole globe. |

## `nasa_cmr` — NASA Earthdata CMR search

Search NASA's Common Metadata Repository (CMR) for Earth science collections (datasets) or granules (files). Supports identifiers, temporal and spatial filters (bounding_box, point, polygon, line, circle), platform/instrument/project, facets and sorting. Returns a compact normalized envelope by default (response_mode raw for upstream metadata) and a next_cursor for Search After pagination: continue by passing only {"cursor": next_cursor}. Collection matches describe datasets; they do not prove granules exist for a given time or place. No API key needed.

Aliases: `nasa/cmr`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `search_type` | `"collections"` \\| `"granules"` |  | `"collections"` | Search collections (datasets) or granules (files). |
| `format` | `"json"` \\| `"umm_json"` \\| `"atom"` \\| `"echo10"` \\| `"iso19115"` \\| `"kml"` \\| `"csv"` \\| `"xml"` \\| `"native"` \\| `"dif"` \\| `"dif10"` \\| `"opendata"` \\| `"stac"` |  | `"json"` | Upstream CMR metadata format. json/umm_json support compact output; others are returned raw. dif, dif10, opendata: collections only; stac: granules only. |
| `response_mode` | `"compact"` \\| `"raw"` |  |  | compact (default for json/umm_json): normalized records. raw: upstream metadata as returned (default for other formats). |
| `fields` | `"concept_id"` \\| `"title"` \\| `"short_name"` \\| `"version"` \\| `"provider"` \\| `"time_start"` \\| `"time_end"` \\| `"platforms"` \\| `"instruments"` \\| `"processing_level"` \\| `"doi"` \\| `"cloud_hosted"` \\| `"online_access"` \\| `"links"` \\| `"summary"` \\| `"collection_concept_id"` \\| `"producer_granule_id"` \\| `"day_night_flag"` \\| `"cloud_cover"` \\| `"browse_available"`[] |  |  | Compact mode only: normalized fields to return. concept_id is always included. Defaults to all fields except summary. |
| `limit` | integer (1–100) |  | `10` | Records per page (1-100). |
| `cursor` | string |  |  | next_cursor from a previous response. Continue with the cursor alone; omitted filters are restored from it. |
| `page` | integer (1–9007199254740991) |  |  | DEPRECATED page-number pagination (CMR page_num). Prefer cursor. Cannot be combined with cursor or offset. |
| `offset` | integer (0–9007199254740991) |  |  | DEPRECATED offset pagination. Prefer cursor. Cannot be combined with cursor or page. |
| `keyword` | string |  |  | Collections only: free-text keyword search. |
| `concept_id` | string or string[] |  |  | Concept ID(s). For granule searches a collection concept ID (C...) also selects that collection, as in CMR. |
| `collection_concept_id` | string or string[] |  |  | Granules only: collection concept ID(s) to search within. |
| `entry_title` | string |  |  | Collection entry title. |
| `short_name` | string or string[] |  |  | Collection short name(s). |
| `version` | string |  |  | Collection version. |
| `provider` | string or string[] |  |  | Provider ID(s), e.g. POCLOUD, LPCLOUD. |
| `readable_granule_name` | string |  |  | Granules only: granule name (supports CMR * and ? wildcards). |
| `producer_granule_id` | string |  |  | Granules only: producer granule ID. |
| `temporal` | string |  |  | Temporal range "start,end" in ISO 8601 (date or date-time, UTC assumed). Either side may be empty, e.g. "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z,". |
| `bounding_box` | string or number[] |  |  | Bounding box west,south,east,north (lon/lat degrees). west > east crosses the antimeridian (supported by CMR). |
| `bbox` | string or number[] |  |  | Compatibility alias for bounding_box (sent to CMR as bounding_box). |
| `point` | string |  |  | Point "lon,lat". |
| `polygon` | string |  |  | Polygon "lon1,lat1,...,lon1,lat1": closed, counter-clockwise (CMR rejects clockwise rings). |
| `line` | string |  |  | Line "lon1,lat1,lon2,lat2,...". |
| `circle` | string |  |  | Circle "lon,lat,radius" with radius in metres (10-6000000). |
| `platform` | string or string[] |  |  | Platform short name(s), e.g. Terra. |
| `instrument` | string or string[] |  |  | Instrument short name(s), e.g. MODIS. |
| `project` | string or string[] |  |  | Project/campaign short name(s). |
| `processing_level_id` | string or string[] |  |  | Collections only: processing level(s), e.g. 3, L2. |
| `granule_data_format` | string or string[] |  |  | Collections only: granule data format(s), e.g. netCDF-4. |
| `cloud_cover` | string |  |  | Granules only: cloud cover range "min,max" in percent. |
| `day_night_flag` | `"DAY"` \\| `"NIGHT"` \\| `"BOTH"` \\| `"UNSPECIFIED"` |  |  | Granules only: DAY, NIGHT, BOTH or UNSPECIFIED. |
| `has_granules` | boolean |  |  | Collections only: require (true) or exclude (false) collections with granules. |
| `cloud_hosted` | boolean |  |  | Collections only: restrict to cloud-hosted (true) or not (false). |
| `doi` | string |  |  | Collections only: DOI, e.g. 10.5067/GHGMR-4FJ04. |
| `downloadable` | boolean |  |  | Only records with (true) or without (false) downloadable data links. |
| `browsable` | boolean |  |  | Only records with (true) or without (false) browse imagery. |
| `online_only` | boolean |  |  | Only online (true) or offline (false) records. |
| `include_facets` | boolean |  |  | Include CMR v2 facets (counts by keyword, platform, ...). |
| `sort_key` | string or string[] |  |  | Sort key(s), "-" prefix for descending. Collections: score, usage_score, entry_title, dataset_id, short_name, entry_id, start_date, end_date, platform, instrument, sensor, provider, revision_date, has_granules, create-data-date, ongoing. Granules: start_date, end_date, producer_granule_id, readable_granule_name, granule_ur, revision_date, cloud_cover, day_night_flag, data_size, provider, platform, instrument, sensor, online_only, browsable, entry_title, short_name, version, campaign, project. |

Returns `structuredContent` matching its advertised `outputSchema` (fields: `status`, `search_type`, `format`, `response_mode`, `results`, `returned_count`, `total_hits`, `next_cursor`, `facets`, `raw`, `source`, `retrieved_at`, `warnings`, `error`).

## `nasa_firms` — NASA FIRMS active fire detections

Active fire/thermal anomaly detections from NASA FIRMS for a bounding box and 1-5 day window. Requires FIRMS_MAP_KEY (not NASA_API_KEY). The legacy latitude/longitude interface now needs radius_km and is converted to a bbox.

Aliases: `nasa/firms`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bbox` | string or number[] |  |  | Area as west,south,east,north in decimal degrees (preferred). Antimeridian-crossing boxes are rejected. |
| `latitude` | number (-90–90) |  |  | Legacy area center latitude; requires longitude and radius_km. |
| `longitude` | number (-180–180) |  |  | Legacy area center longitude; requires latitude and radius_km. |
| `radius_km` | number (>0–500) |  |  | Half-width in kilometres of the box built around latitude/longitude (converted to a bbox before querying). |
| `days` | integer (1–5) |  | `1` | DAY_RANGE: number of days of detections (1-5). |
| `date` | string |  |  | First day of the window (YYYY-MM-DD); FIRMS returns [date, date + days - 1]. Omit for the most recent data. |
| `source` | `"LANDSAT_NRT"` \\| `"MODIS_NRT"` \\| `"MODIS_SP"` \\| `"VIIRS_NOAA20_NRT"` \\| `"VIIRS_NOAA20_SP"` \\| `"VIIRS_NOAA21_NRT"` \\| `"VIIRS_SNPP_NRT"` \\| `"VIIRS_SNPP_SP"` |  | `"VIIRS_SNPP_NRT"` | FIRMS sensor/product. *_NRT is near real-time, *_SP is standard processing. |
| `limit` | integer (1–2000) |  | `100` | Maximum detections returned (1-2000). total_detections reports the full count. |

Returns `structuredContent` matching its advertised `outputSchema` (fields: `status`, `query`, `total_detections`, `returned_count`, `columns`, `detections`, `source`, `retrieved_at`, `warnings`, `error`).

## `nasa_images` — NASA Image and Video Library search

Search NASA's Image and Video Library. Returns item metadata and URLs, with a bounded number of preview thumbnails embedded.

Aliases: `nasa/images`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | string | yes |  | Free-text search terms. |
| `media_type` | `"image"` \\| `"video"` \\| `"audio"` |  |  | Restrict to one media type. |
| `year_start` | string |  |  | Earliest year (YYYY). |
| `year_end` | string |  |  | Latest year (YYYY). |
| `page` | integer (1–100) |  | `1` | Result page (1-based). |
| `page_size` | integer (1–100) |  | `10` | Results per page (1-100). |
| `max_images` | integer (0–5) |  | `3` | How many preview thumbnails to embed (0-5). Every item is listed with its URLs. |

## `nasa_exoplanet` — NASA Exoplanet Archive query

Query the NASA Exoplanet Archive through its TAP service (ADQL). Tables use current TAP names such as ps, pscomppars, cumulative and toi.

Aliases: `nasa/exoplanet`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `table` | string | yes |  | TAP table, e.g. ps (Planetary Systems), pscomppars, cumulative (Kepler KOI), toi. |
| `select` | string |  |  | Columns to return (ADQL select list). Defaults to *. |
| `where` | string |  |  | ADQL WHERE condition, e.g. disc_year > 2020 and discoverymethod = 'Transit'. |
| `order` | string |  |  | ADQL ORDER BY expression, e.g. pl_name. |
| `limit` | integer (1–1000) |  | `100` | Maximum rows (1-1000). |
| `format` | `"json"` \\| `"csv"` |  | `"json"` | Result format. |

## `nasa_mars_rover` — NASA Mars Rover Photos (retired upstream)

DEPRECATED: the upstream Mars Rover Photos API (api.nasa.gov/mars-photos) has been returning HTTP 404 "No such app" since at least 2026-09-29. Calls still query it and report the upstream status accurately; no photos are fabricated. Requires NASA_API_KEY.

| `page` | integer (1–9007199254740991) |  |  | Result page (25 photos per page). |

## `nasa_eonet` — NASA EONET natural events

Natural events (wildfires, storms, volcanoes, ice, ...) from the Earth Observatory Natural Event Tracker. Filters are sent exactly as given; no automatic broadening.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |

| `category` | string |  |  | EONET category ID(s), comma-separated: e.g. wildfires, severeStorms, volcanoes, seaLakeIce. |
| `days` | integer (1–3650) |  | `60` | Only events active within this many prior days. |
| `source` | string |  |  | EONET source ID(s), comma-separated, e.g. InciWeb,EO. |
| `status` | `"open"` \\| `"closed"` \\| `"all"` |  | `"all"` | Event status filter. |
| `limit` | integer (1–500) |  | `50` | Maximum number of events (1-500). |

| `removed` | boolean |  |  | List objects removed from Sentry. |

| `QUANTITIES` | string |  |  | Observer quantities, e.g. 'A' or '1,2,20,23'. |
| `OUT_UNITS` | `"KM-S"` \\| `"AU-D"` \\| `"KM-D"` |  |  | Output units for vector/element tables. |

## `jpl_horizons_file` — JPL Horizons ephemerides (file input)

Same as jpl_horizons, but submits the parameters as a Horizons input file (POST to horizons_file.api).

Aliases: `jpl/horizons_file`, `jpl/horizons-file`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | `"json"` \\| `"text"` |  | `"json"` | Response format. |
| `COMMAND` | string | yes |  | Target, e.g. '499' (Mars), '1;' (Ceres), 'C/2020 F3'. |
| `OBJ_DATA` | `"YES"` \\| `"NO"` |  |  | Include object data. |
| `MAKE_EPHEM` | `"YES"` \\| `"NO"` |  |  | Generate an ephemeris. |
| `EPHEM_TYPE` | `"OBSERVER"` \\| `"VECTORS"` \\| `"ELEMENTS"` |  |  | Ephemeris type. |
| `CENTER` | string |  |  | Coordinate center, e.g. '500@399' (geocentric). |
| `START_TIME` | string |  |  | Start time, e.g. '2024-01-01'. |
| `STOP_TIME` | string |  |  | Stop time, e.g. '2024-01-02'. |
| `STEP_SIZE` | string |  |  | Step size, e.g. '1d' or '1h'. |
| `QUANTITIES` | string |  |  | Observer quantities, e.g. 'A' or '1,2,20,23'. |
| `OUT_UNITS` | `"KM-S"` \\| `"AU-D"` \\| `"KM-D"` |  |  | Output units for vector/element tables. |

## `jpl_periodic_orbits` — JPL three-body periodic orbits

Periodic orbits (halo, DRO, Lyapunov, ...) in three-body systems from the JPL Three-Body Periodic Orbits database.

Aliases: `jpl/periodic_orbits`, `jpl/periodic-orbits`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sys` | string | yes |  | Three-body system, e.g. earth-moon, sun-earth, mars-phobos. |
| `family` | string | yes |  | Orbit family, e.g. halo, dro, lyapunov, vertical, axial, butterfly. |
| `libr` | integer (1–5) |  |  | Libration point 1-5 (required by some families). |
| `branch` | string |  |  | Branch (required by some families), e.g. N or S. |
| `periodmin` | number |  |  | Minimum period. |
| `periodmax` | number |  |  | Maximum period. |
| `periodunits` | `"s"` \\| `"h"` \\| `"d"` \\| `"TU"` |  |  | Units for periodmin/periodmax. |
| `jacobimin` | number |  |  | Minimum Jacobi constant. |
| `jacobimax` | number |  |  | Maximum Jacobi constant. |
| `stabmin` | number |  |  | Minimum stability index. |
| `stabmax` | number |  |  | Maximum stability index. |

## `jpl_scout` — JPL Scout NEOCP hazard assessment

JPL Scout trajectory analysis and hazard assessment for unconfirmed objects on the Minor Planet Center NEO Confirmation Page.

Aliases: `jpl/scout`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tdes` | string |  |  | NEOCP temporary designation (object mode). |
| `plot` | string |  |  | Object mode: base64 plots to include: el (elements), ca (close approach), sr (systematic ranging), colon-separated. |
| `file` | `"list"` \\| `"mpc"` |  |  | Object mode: include the observation file as a list or in MPC format. |
| `orbits` | boolean |  |  | Object mode: include sampled orbits. |
| `n_orbits` | integer (1–1000) |  |  | Object mode: number of sampled orbits (1-1000). |
| `limit` | integer (1–1000) |  |  | List mode: return at most this many objects. Applied by this server; Scout has no limit parameter. |
